profileSnapshot.name: Explore
profileSnapshot.description: Read-only search agent for broad fan-out searches - when answering means sweeping many files, directories, or naming conventions and you only need the conclusion, not the file dumps. It reads excerpts rather than whole files, so it locates code; it doesn't review or audit it. Specify search breadth: "medium" for moderate exploration, "very thorough" for multiple locations and naming conventions.

prompt:
Explore two things and report concisely (read-only; DO NOT print full API keys, only first 8 chars):

1. The failover router at /Users/macbook/.config/opencode/scripts/failover/ (router.mjs, proxy.mjs, core.mjs, openai-oauth.mjs, anthropic-messages.mjs) and config /Users/macbook/.config/opencode/failover.json:
   - The `providers` section of failover.json: list every provider entry (name, baseURL, kind, endpoint type) — especially `zai-coding-plan`, `opencode-go`, `opencode`, `openai`.
   - How proxy.mjs builds the upstream URL for an api-key provider (does it append /chat/completions? does kind "messages" exist and how is it used?).
   - How health checks probe upstreams (/models?).
   - Whether a provider entry supports custom headers or auth styles beyond Bearer key.

2. The available Z.ai / ZCode plan credentials on this machine:
   - /Users/macbook/.local/share/opencode/auth.json: does provider `zai-coding-plan` exist, its type, and the first 8 chars of its key. Also list other provider names (no keys).
   - /Users/macbook/.zcode/v2/provider_config.json: the zai-api provider entry (first 8 chars of the apiKey only) and its exact access type string.
   - Compare: are the opencode zai-coding-plan key and the ZCode zai-api key the same (prefix match)?

3. Web research (WebSearch/WebFetch): the official Z.ai API endpoint for coding-plan API keys — what baseURL accepts OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions for GLM models with a Z.ai coding plan key (e.g. https://api.z.ai/api/coding/paas/v4), and whether there is any documented way to use a "ZCode Start Plan" / zcode-plan entitlement (account-based, from the ZCode desktop app) outside the ZCode app via API. Report URLs found.

Report: providers table from failover.json, URL-building logic summary, key comparison result, and Z.ai endpoint findings with sources.
